summary: Iter 216h108 — Equipment Import / Onboarding Flow testing complete. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend code review confirms correct implementation of inline panels for QR print and equipment import.

success_rate.frontend: Code review passed - unable to fully test UI due to auth context (master admin doesn't have Pulse Pro tenant access)

seed_data_creation: Equipment imported from Carshalton_iGym.xlsx - 5 new items (106 skipped as duplicates from previous imports)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 216h108 five-fold fix verified: (1) Excel-date parsing works correctly (45979 → 2025-11-18), (2) XLSX support via openpyxl, (3) unified template between Master Admin and customer endpoints, (4) inline onboarding panels for import + QR print (cta_inline instead of cta_route), (5) chunked auto-find images in LiteEquipmentTab.js. All backend APIs working. Frontend components correctly implemented per code review.

date_parser.details: parse_date_cell() correctly handles: Excel serials (45979 → 2025-11-18), UK dates (15/01/2024 → 2024-01-15), ISO dates (2024-01-15), empty strings, None, garbage text

equipment_template_endpoint.details: GET /api/account/import/equipment/template returns CSV with correct headers matching Master Admin template

onboarding_endpoint.details: GET /api/account/onboarding returns 9 steps including print_qr_codes (cta_inline='qr_print') and import_machines (cta_inline='equipment_import'). Both have NO cta_route so they open inline.

equipment_import_endpoint.details: POST /api/account/import/equipment accepts .xlsx files, parses Excel serial dates correctly, returns imported/skipped counts with organization_id

bulk_auto_lookup_chunking.details: POST /api/equipment/lookup-images/batch?limit=8 endpoint exists and responds correctly

frontend_inline_panels.details: onboarding.js correctly branches on cta_inline before route/section dispatch. EquipmentImportInline.js and QrPrintInline.js components exist with correct data-testid attributes.

frontend_chunked_autolookup.details: LiteEquipmentTab.js runBulkAutoLookup() loops calling POST /api/equipment/lookup-images/batch?limit=8 until total_examined < 8. Shows progress text 'Searching manufacturer websites… X/Y'. Error handling surfaces real backend detail.

notes: Frontend UI testing was limited because the master admin account doesn't have a Pulse Pro tenant context to access the Account Settings onboarding checklist. The onboarding checklist is designed for Pulse Pro operators (owners/managers), not platform admins. Backend API tests confirm all endpoints work correctly. Code review confirms frontend components are correctly implemented.
